  • Classes in dev.relism.flash.bytes used by dev.relism.flash.bytes
    Class
    Description
    ArrayBackedByteView
    Capability interface for a ByteView that is a contiguous slice of a single backing byte[] — as opposed to a SegmentedByteView, which spans several arrays and cannot expose a single (array, offset) pair.
    PooledSlice
    A reusable view over a slice of an array, replacing the per-call new ByteView() { ... } anonymous-class allocation that used to live in Http1HeaderMap.view: instead of allocating a fresh view object (plus its capturing instance) on every call, a small SlicePool of these hands out an existing instance, repositioned in place.
